a: Compassion shown to someone in your power
An AI company said Oct. 8 its docs, slides and design tools are now on every one of its paid and free ___
n: Which plan you are on decides which AI tools you get. When a feature moves from paid-only to every plan, more people can try it at work without asking for a budget. Before you build a habit on a tool, check what your plan includes and what your company approved.

sources.title: An AI company opens its docs, slides and design tools to every plan, and adds dashboards and animation (Anthropic)
